outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the upper drawer handle in frames 20–86 (left_ego_image and wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward in frames 105–124, exposing its side and the gap behind its front (image and left_ego_image). The drawer remains visibly open through frame 204 as the gripper releases and withdraws (left_ego_image and wrist_image). No failed attempt, damage, or displacement of unrelated objects is established.
